sva: p_out_valid_equals_full: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) out_valid == full);
intent_summary: The buffer output-valid flag should reflect full state.

sva: p_in_ready_when_empty: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) !full |-> in_ready);
intent_summary: An empty buffer should be ready for input.

sva: p_data_stable_while_stalled: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) out_valid && !out_ready |=> out_valid && $stable(out_data));
intent_summary: Buffered output data should remain stable while stalled.
